audit_items.proof_trace: No `liquidator != borrower` check exists anywhere in the liquidation call chain: `pre_liquidation_check` (L48-60) only checks market validity and permission; `handle_liquidation` (market.move:496-544) only checks obligation market membership and collateral settings; `liquidation_inner` (market.move:691-793) only checks non-zero repay and the health-factor gate. The `Obligation` struct has no owner address field, and `liquidate`/`liquidate_as_coin` accept only `obligation_id: ID` — never the borrower's `ObligationOwnerCap` — so `ctx.sender()` is never compared to the obligation owner.
audit_items.attack_scenario: A borrower whose position is undercollateralized borrows debt tokens via the protocol's own `borrow_flash_loan` (same Sui PTB), calls `liquidate` targeting their own `obligation_id`, receives `repaid_debt * (1 + liquidation_incentive)` worth of collateral back to themselves, and repays the flash loan — capturing the liquidation incentive that would otherwise reward an external liquidator and incentivize protocol health maintenance.
